issues.detail: The skill requires Python 3.10+ or Node.js 18+, which is a minor platform assumption.
The instructions mention installing intuit-oauth via pip without specifying a checksum, which is a medium security concern.

scenarios.name: generate-qbo-profit-loss
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully satisfies the rubric by calling profit_and_loss, using summary_rows, and listing the top 5 expense categories; Response A does not include any code or calls to the required functions.

scenarios.name: create-invoice-and-payment
scenarios.rationale: Both responses omit the required upsert_customer call, so they only partially satisfy the rubric.

scenarios.name: refresh-oauth-token
scenarios.rationale: Response B fully satisfies the rubric by using get_valid_token, handling invalid_grant, and calling auth_url, whereas Response A lacks the required get_valid_token call and auth_url function.
